_about: Example settings for backend/updates-worker.mjs. Placeholders only: this file holds no credential and nothing here is deployed. Secrets are set with the platform's secret store, never committed.
name: spectre-updates

_notes.UPDATES_ENABLED: The Worker answers 503 to every request until this is the string "true" and UPDATES_DB, RESEND_API_KEY, UPDATES_TOKEN_SECRET and UPDATES_ORIGIN are all set.
_notes.UPDATES_POSTAL_ADDRESS: The sender's business mailing address, required in the welcome email. While it is empty, confirmations still work and each welcome email is held in updates_outbox with blocker postal_address_missing. Do not put a home or apartment address here.
_notes.triggers: No Cron trigger. Held and failed welcome emails are retried only when someone calls retryOutbox().
